answers.ask: How tall is each floor - 67 floors at normal height is well over a thousand studs, so should this be built and framed floor by floor?

## Enriched image prompt
Create a bright, colorful, stylized 3D obby tower containing exactly 67 compact stacked floors. Build and frame each floor as its own practical stage while preserving one continuous vertical ascent through the full tower. Use a classic obstacle-tower vocabulary of ordered platforms, timed sections, and climb elements, keeping every floor visually distinct enough to read in sequence without enlarging its footprint. Place one safe checkpoint pad at every transition between consecutive floors, for exactly 66 checkpoint pads, and finish with one simple completion reward area at the top of floor 67. Keep the tower's stacked silhouette authoritative and do not flatten all stages into one unreadable frame.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Obby & Platformer.

## Shape and preset
Use `course-tower`, Path (Tower / Spiral Ascent), because all 67 compact stages stack vertically above one another. The matching preset is Tower Obby, retaining its ordered track, timed obstacles, climb elements, and top reward, with author-requested checkpoints added between every floor.

## Config requirements
Use `path-track` for the continuous 67-floor ascent, `obstacle-timing` for timed stage sections, and `obstacle-climb` for vertical climb elements. Use the drawn forms of `checkpoint-respawn` for exactly 66 transition pads and `winner-zone` for one bright completion area at the top.

## Layout requirements
Place one free-text SpawnZone at the base of floor one. Place exactly 66 `checkpoint-respawn` Checkpoints, one at each floor-to-floor transition after floors one through 66. Place exactly one `winner-zone` WinnerZone at the top of floor 67. Each checkpoint must return the player to its safe pad rather than the tower base.

## Layout components
The build contains one tower, exactly 67 compact stacked floor zones, one continuous ordered ascent, timed and climb obstacles, exactly 66 checkpoint pads, one base start, and one top completion area. Vertical connectors join consecutive floors without skipping stages. The tower shell or open edge defines the boundary, and floor-by-floor framing preserves obstacle detail despite the total height.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: each compact floor's obstacle chain and its connection to the next checkpoint must be valid before the 67 plans are assembled and dressed as a tower.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale is small per floor because obstacle and checkpoint detail must remain legible; the 67-floor whole is handled through vertical decomposition rather than one huge frame. The theme is bright, colorful, and stylized like a classic block-based obby tower. Modifier `P6` is required by the Obby & Platformer genre, and modifier `P2` is required because many playable floors overhang one another.
